note: Rendered contrast measured off real screenshots of the running guide, against what Model's contrast arithmetic predicts for the same case. This exists because a single earlier measurement was read as proof that the model was wrong by 1.25 ratio points, and a design was refused on that basis. It was not the model that was wrong: the old pass measured the failure GLYPH, drawn at opacity 0.8, and compared it against a value computed for the 0.52 text rung. See docs/UX-GUIDE-AT-SCALE.md section 16.
method: grim capture of the live shell with the guide open, the modal colour of a tight crop taken as the background, and the single most-contrasting pixel in that crop taken as the fully-covered glyph stroke. Repeated on a second capture; identical to two decimals both times.
capturedAtNote: capturedAt above and the method's 'repeated on a second capture' describe the six original rows. Rows carrying their own capturedAt were appended by the live pass of that date (docs/QA-RESULTS.md, 'Live pass 2026-09-21, segment A', section 1), each a single capture unless its captures field says otherwise; its bar rows were captured with the guide CLOSED, because the open guide's scrim composites over the bar (docs/CONTRAST-RULING.md, 'Measurement rule, learned 2026-09-21').
toleranceNote: Every measurement lands BELOW its predicted value, never above, because even the peak pixel of 10px text is not always fully covered. The model is therefore slightly OPTIMISTIC, which is why a target must sit above 4.5 and never on it.
sizeClassNote: F-CAL-1, lead's ruling 2026-09-21: the model's error is size-dependent, so every row carries a sizeClass and the test derives each row's allowed error from it. 'text' is regular-weight text 11 px and larger (the 14 px name, the 11 px detail line), 'caption' is regular-weight 10 px (group entry count, footer lines, Sources count), 'bold-caption' is bold 10 px (the GROUPS host header, which renders at model accuracy), 'glyph' is the 28 px empty-state glyph and the bar glyph. A caption row is allowed tolerance.captionRel times its measured value, because 10 px regular strokes never reach full coverage and the shortfall scales with the ratio (0.17 to 0.79 on the 2026-09-21 rows, 11 to 13 per cent); every other class is allowed tolerance.abs, which is maxAbsError and was not raised. A row without a known sizeClass is refused by the test, not defaulted.
knownDeviationNote: F-CAL-2, lead's ruling 2026-09-21: a row carrying knownDeviation is outside its class tolerance for a reason on the board under that id, and the test holds it STRICTLY: the pinned set is asserted by name, an unpinned row must hold, and a pinned row that comes to hold goes red so the pin comes off in the same change. The three pinned rows are 11 and 14 px text ON THE CURSOR FILL, 0.17 to 0.25 off; the model arithmetic is right (the fill measures as modelled, the ink is the text token less peak coverage), and the pass measured a different string on each surface, so the surface is not separated from the glyphs. Pinning by name is the alternative to widening a tolerance, which this file's own history is a check against.
